hard_rules: Captured documentElement.clientWidth equals the declared CSS width; a browser minimum-width substitution is a failed fixture, not a pass.
scrollWidth is no greater than clientWidth plus one CSS pixel; wide tables use keyboard-focusable bounded containers.
Every focus target has a stable nonempty identity, focus order follows DOM reading order, and no duplicate anonymous target substitutes for proof.
Golden screenshots or DOM frames cover all 32 fixture/surface/frame cells and are hash-stable across two runs.
